messages.subject: the student-t problem
parts:
Just to boil it down to essentials:

- Here's a model that works:

schools_code <- '
data {
int<lower=0> J; // number of schools
real y[J]; // estimated treatment effects
real<lower=0> sigma[J]; // s.e. of effect estimates
}
parameters {
real theta[J];
real mu;
real<lower=0> tau;
}
model {
for (j in 1:J){
theta[j] ~ student_t (4, mu, tau);
y[j] ~ normal (theta[j], sigma);
}
}
'


- Here's a model that fails:

schools_code <- '
data {
int<lower=0> J; // number of schools
real y[J]; // estimated treatment effects
real<lower=0> sigma[J]; // s.e. of effect estimates
}
parameters {
real theta[J];
real mu;
real<lower=0> tau;
}
model {
for (j in 1:J){
theta[j] ~ student_t (4, mu, tau);
y[j] ~ student_t (4, theta[j], sigma);
}
}
'
